corpus.title: The Ethnos Corpus
corpus.summary: The database and the pipeline that fills it: what the data is, where it comes from, how it is collected, how it is repaired, how it is scored, and what it does not contain.

the-problem.title: The problem: there is no source
the-problem.summary: Why no field-wide source exists, what each available source can and cannot say, and the trust rule that follows from it.

data-model.title: The shape of the data
data-model.summary: Works against publications, the entity model, and what is actually held in the tables.

sources.title: Sources
sources.summary: Every source in use, what it is authoritative for, what it gets wrong, and one that was assessed and refused.

collection.title: Collection
collection.summary: Worklists, API cost as a design constraint, caching, and the source archive.

cleaning.title: Cleaning and repair
cleaning.summary: The four recurring corruptions and the rule adopted against each.

relevance.title: Relevance: scoring and filtering
relevance.summary: Tiers, the score, the four constraints, the classes — and why nothing is deleted.

incompleteness.title: What is missing
incompleteness.summary: The measured gaps, and what each one is the boundary of.

files-and-availability.title: Files and availability
files-and-availability.summary: What an availability record is, what is not stored, and what is not verified.

operations.title: Operations
operations.summary: The daily run, its ordering constraints, reversibility, and scale.
